error_message: IMP-11: 画廊/统计缓存持久化 — 缓存到期时同步写回 DB，防重启后缓存空窗期
root_cause: 缺失：set 时未写 DB、stop 时未 flush、start 时未恢复
fix:
1. cache.py: 新增 _DbPending 缓冲区 + _serialize/_deserialize + restore_from_db + flush_to_db + _flush_all_to_db
2. db.py: 新增 cache_store 表 + save_cache_batch/load_cache_snapshot/delete_cache_batch
3. main.py: gallery_cache 传入 persist_db=db，lifespan 中 restore_from_db/flush_to_db
4. worker.py: _finish 出图完成时 invalidate_prefix('gallery:')

error_message: pytest tests/test_tryingopen.py: tool-call emulation tests failed; fenced tool variant returned None
root_cause: _last_json_object selected the innermost arguments object instead of the outer tool-call object, and parser did not unwrap the tool wrapper variant.
fix: Prefer JSON objects recognized as tool calls and unwrap tool/tool_call/tool_name wrappers before extracting name and arguments.
